ValidationRule.description: Limit the chapter name to 57 characters.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Type__c) ), ISPICKVAL(Type__c,'Chapter'), NOT(ISBLANK(Name)), LEN(Name) > 57 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Chapter name must be within 57 characters.
